## Requirements

From the contract's In-scope list (1–4) and design B4 §G9/G7-item-5/G10:

1. **G9 round-close checks** (`docs/build/tools/check_round_close.py`,
   stdlib; structure mode in `make docs-check`, `--round-tail
   <round-start>` mode for the tail): tail mode requires a `## Round N
   review` section dated within the round; RISK ids unique — the landed
   duplicates (RISK-P5-04 ×2, RISK-P20-01 ×2) pass only through appended,
   dated rename records inside a `## Round N review` (never a renamed
   row); every deferred RISK row is routed to a home (backlog `sources`
   owner, an id-cell `→ BL-nnn` cite, or an appended corrections record)
   with re-route targets open (RISK-P21-03's defect class = unrouted;
   RISK-P18-04's BL-042-closed re-home recorded as a corrections row →
   BL-087); each manifest `### Round` chain banner cites an existing spec
   part/section, Round 11 → Part XII §56, Rounds 2–9 exempt by list (not
   retrofitted, F-32 §52); `docs/traceability.md` and
   `docs/build/TICKET_VS_SPEC.md` carry appended "frozen historical view"
   pointers.
2. **Capstone two-sum (G7 item 5, SIG-ENG-041):** a coverage-count packet
   under the declared path patterns (`docs/build/readouts/ACCEPT-*.md`,
   `GATE-ACCEPT*.md`, `docs/build/CAPSTONE_*.md`, the Round-11 acceptance
   packets) must declare `coverage two-sum[<layer>]: engineering closed =
   N · requirement satisfied = M`, recomputed from
   `docs/build/COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` — engineering closed = MET +
   MET-DIFFERENTLY + MET-ENGINEERED, requirement satisfied = MET +
   MET-DIFFERENTLY — per status layer; a bare "N MET" or MET-ENGINEERED
   folded into MET fails; historical packets exempt by date, listed
   (no vacuous exemption).
3. **Tail probe-sweep contract (G10 tail column):**
   `docs/build/tools/record_policy/tail_probe_sweep.toml` lists all ten
   G10 probes (route allow-list/absence, release record + id,
   live-config drift, monitoring liveness, attribution sanity,
   jurisdiction–coordinate consistency, API-vs-release parity, number
   truth, fixture-sentinel scan, claim markers) each with owner row,
   producer command and expected `sig.probe-run/1` record path; at the
   tail each listed probe needs a record ≤ 24 h old at `--at` that
   evaluated something (empty `checks` or all-`skipped` fails, G11).
4. **Fixtures:** a tail missing the risk-register round section (fail); a
   packet adding MET-ENGINEERED into MET (fail) vs a correct two-sum
   (pass); a probe record 25 h old (fail) — plus the full mutation set in
   `docs/build/tools/test_check_round_close.py` (25 tests).
5. **CI:** structure mode joins `make docs-check` (`docs-check-round-close`)
   and is a named step in the CI `docs` job; every leg reports
   offered/evaluated (SIG-ENG-042) and a non-empty candidate set
   evaluated-zero exits 3.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A fixture tail missing the risk-register section fails; one adding
      MET-ENGINEERED into MET fails; the correct fixtures pass (tests).
      *(deterministic · layer: engineered)*
- [ ] Structure mode is green on the tree in `make docs-check` (risk-id
      disambiguation appended, banners mapped, frozen-view pointers
      present). *(deterministic · layer: engineered)*
- [ ] The tail contract lists every G10 probe with its owner; a stale or
      vacuous probe record fails (test). *(deterministic · layer: engineered)*
- [ ] Verification green: `make check` and `make docs-check`; every new
      behaviour has a test that fails if it is removed; tests assert
      invariants, never a living record (OM-15); requirement ids stamped
      in the PR; anything not automatically verifiable is a DEFERRALS row
      with `owner:`/`trigger:`; an ADR for every deviation and owned
      decision. *(deterministic · layer: engineered)*
- [ ] PR head checks read head-bound after push (`ci_boundary.py`;
      python, docs, composed, security, web) recorded as the `ci:` line;
      red, pending or missing → `blockedOn` (OM-05, SIG-MEM-007).
      *(deterministic · layer: engineered)*
- [ ] Closeout is one commit after the PR exists (OM-02): this run
      ledger, `docs/build/pr/P34.33.md`, a BUILD_INDEX row under
      `## Round 11` (12 columns incl. `harness`), the LEDGER advanced,
      the `rows 1-N as of` line of `docs/build/README.md` updated.
      *(deterministic · layer: engineered)*
- [ ] Record rules: a new coverage verdict word extends
      `check_coverage_matrix.VERDICTS` in the same change; source flips
      read `FLIPPED <date> (<gate|ADR>)`; DEFERRALS lead-token changes
      carry matching `obligation-event/1` transitions; protected records
      only gain lines (`memory_guard.py all --staged` green before the
      closeout commit). *(deterministic · layer: engineered)*

## Plan

1. `docs/build/tools/check_round_close.py` (stdlib; exits 0/1/2/3;
   offered/evaluated on every leg): `_risk_scan` one-pass parse of the
   register (definition rows, rename records, deferred-class rows,
   corrections tables, dated `## Round N review` sections); the banner
   leg section-scoped to `## The chain`; the packet leg reads the TOML
   policy's declared patterns + dated exemptions; the sweep leg reads
   `tail_probe_sweep.toml`; tail mode calls
   `adr_triggers.check(round_tail=…)` — P34.32's mode, never duplicated.
2. `record_policy/round_close.toml` (`round-close-policy/1`): banner
   exemptions + Round-11 cite requirement + packet patterns + dated
   packet exemptions.
3. `record_policy/tail_probe_sweep.toml` (`tail-probe-sweep/1`): the ten
   G10 probes with `requires` ids, `owner`, `command`, `record` path.
4. Record edits (append-only): nine Round-11 manifest banners gain `spec:
   Part XII (§56)` cites; the risk register gains the `RISK-P18-04`
   re-home record (BL-042 closed → BL-087); `traceability.md` and
   `TICKET_VS_SPEC.md` gain the appended frozen-view pointers.
5. ADR-199 (the owned decisions record) + Appendix F row via spec_src +

6. `docs-check-round-close` Makefile target inside `docs-check`; named

7. `docs/build/tools/test_check_round_close.py` — fixture trees under
   tmp_path (BM-TEST-01): a valid baseline passes; one mutation per test
   makes exactly that leg fail; `check(REPO_ROOT)` real-tree sanity is
